evals.prompt: Generate a complete color tokens.css for a developer SaaS tool using Linear Dark palette.
evals.expected_output: Complete production-ready :root and dark mode CSS block with semantic tokens and WCAG AA contrast validation.
expectations: Emits complete CSS block starting with :root for light mode default
Includes .dark and [data-theme="dark"] override block for manual toggle
Passes WCAG AA contrast ratio threshold (text >= 4.5:1, UI components >= 3:1)
Adheres to dark mode rules: no pure black #000 or pure white #fff, preserves accent hue

evals.prompt: 为一款高端护肤品礼盒包装设计一套平面与印刷色彩规范，主色为墨玉绿。
evals.expected_output: Physical print and packaging color specification adhering to CMYK and Pantone standards with prepress rules.
expectations: Applies 60-30-10 golden ratio allocation for physical packaging
Specifies CMYK values (FOGRA39 standard) and corresponding Pantone Spot Colors
Strictly enforces Standard Black (K:100) for small text/barcodes
Specifies Rich Black with Total Ink Coverage (TIC) strictly <= 300% for solid backgrounds
Includes substrate compensation guidance for coated vs uncoated vs specialty paper
